thesis: The page is a roof cross-section: each section is one layer in build order, and the left-edge diagram adds that layer as you scroll.

signature.name: Layer Stack Cross-Section
signature.summary: Vertical roof cross-section in left margin; each page section adds one layer (deck, membrane, underlayment, shingles, ridge) via scroll-driven clip-path. Hook: data-sw-signature='layer-stack'.

motion.intro: Filmstrip frames pull in from right like contact sheet, settle with shingle frame centered; 1.1s, skippable.
stories: Layer SVG segments slide in from right and lock on stack (verb: stack)
Photos unclip via clip-path inset wipe (verb: wipe)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms
